title: Orbit Follower
text: Orbit location of interest using UAV, 6 inputs, 7 outputs; {UAV type} sets the type of UAV, {Minimum orbit radius (m)}, {Minimum lookahead distance (m)}, {External reset} sets the reset trigger source, {Show CrossTrackError output port} sets the output cross track error and {Show NumTurns output port} sets the output UAV waypoint status. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Pose
ports.summary: Current UAV pose [x y z course] vector

ports.name: Center
ports.summary: Center of orbit [x y z] vector

ports.name: LookaheadDistance
ports.summary: Lookahead distance for tracking orbit positive scalar

ports.name: ResetNumTurns
ports.summary: Reset for counting turns numeric signal

ports.name: LookaheadPoint
ports.summary: Lookahead point on path [x y z] position vector

ports.name: CrossTrackError
ports.summary: Cross track error from UAV position to path positive numeric scalar

ports.name: NumTurns
ports.summary: Number of times the UAV has completed the orbit numeric scalar

params.name: Minimum orbit radius (m)
params.values: Minimum orbit radius 1 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.name: Minimum lookahead distance (m)
params.values: Minimum lookahead distance 0.1 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.name: Show CrossTrackError output port
params.values: Output cross track error off (default) | on

params.name: Show NumTurns output port
params.values: Output UAV waypoint status off (default) | on
